prompt: Photograph supplied by Shiron Beskiwin on 2026-09-08. Not generated, not stock. Cropped east-gravity from the supplied 1254x1254 original keeping the whole subject; converted to a two-colour duotone mapping shadows to #2a2a2c and highlights to #f7f5f0 with sigmoidal contrast 3.6/47%, then a gentle radial vignette (white to #b8b8b8, multiply) so the subject reads inside the arch without the vignette eating the shape's contour. Encoded to WebP at 1000x1400 (q90) and 640x896 (q88). The arch itself is a CSS border-radius, not baked into the raster.
